harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «قرآنًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «أنزلناه». The clause «لعلكم تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «أحسن» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «القصص» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of a passive participle. «بما أوحينا»: the bāʾ is a preposition; «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نقص». «هذا» is the mafʿūl bihi of «أوحينا», and «القرآن» is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative. «وإن كنت من قبله لمن الغافلين»: the wāw is circumstantial; «إن» is lightened from the heavy form (inna). The preposition and its genitive noun «من قبله» is attached to «الغافلين». The lām is the one that distinguishes the lightened «إن» from the negating «إن», so it attaches to the lightened one. The preposition and its genitive noun «من الغافلين» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun «نا» in «أوحينا».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «إذ قال»: an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from {أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ}. «يا أبت»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which has been replaced by tāʾ; the kasra of harmony has been moved to the tāʾ, and the tāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «أحد عشر»: two parts, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «الشمس» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «أحد عشر»; this is a case of mentioning the particular after the general by way of detailing, because the sun and the moon were included in His saying «أحد عشر كوكبا». The clause «رأيتهم» is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ساجدين», and «ساجدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); He treated them as rational beings.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «يا بني»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «فيكيدوا»: the fāʾ is causal, and an imperfect verb accusative by an implied «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no relating, then a plotting". The preposition and its genitive noun «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «كيدًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «فيكيدوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «وكذلك»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "He will choose you with a choosing like that choosing". The clause «يجتبيك» is conjoined to the answer of the vocative {لا تَقْصُصْ}. «كما أتمها»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, i.e. "He will complete it with a completing like His completing of it". «إبراهيم» is a genitive (majrūr) badal (substitute). «من قبل»: an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أتمها».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «لقد كان»: the lām falls in the answer to the oath. The preposition and its genitive noun «في يوسف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان». The preposition and its genitive noun «للسائلين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, the object of an implied «اذكر». The lām in «ليوسف» is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ), and «يوسف» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «ونحن عصبة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun (نا), and the clause «إن أبانا لفي ضلال» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «أرضًا» is accusative by removal of the preposition «في». «يخلُ»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), falling in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. The preposition and its genitive noun «من بعده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صالحين».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «يلتقطه»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «ما لك»: an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «لا تأمنا»: «لا» is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the nūn because of the assimilation (idghām); the pronoun «نا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «لا تأمنَّا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in «لك». The clause «وإنَّا له لناصحون» is a ḥāl from the object pronoun in «تأمنَّا», and the preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to «ناصحون».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The two adverbs «معنا» and «غدًا» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسله», and the verb «يرتع» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), falling in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. [Translator's note: the quotation marks in this sentence are misplaced in the source text; they are restored here according to the sense.] The clause «وإنَّا له لحافظون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «أرسله», and the preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «حافظون».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The lām in «ليحزنني» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The maṣdar «أن تذهبوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يحزن», and the maṣdar «أن يأكله» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وأخاف» is conjoined to the clause «ليحزنني», and the clause «وأنتم عنه غافلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «لئن»: the lām is the one paving the way for the oath; «إن» is conditional. The clause «ونحن عصبة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «أكله», and the clause «إنا إذًا لخاسرون» is the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «فلما ذهبوا»: the fāʾ is resumptive; «لما» is a particle of "occurrence upon occurrence". The maṣdar «أن يجعلوه» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verb «أجمع» is transitive by itself and with «على». «جعل» here means "cast". The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. «جعلوه فيها». «لتنبئنهم»: the lām falls in the answer to an implied oath; an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the nūn is for emphasis, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. The clause «وأوحينا» is conjoined to the implied apodosis «جعلوه». The clause «لتنبئنهم» is the answer to an implied oath, with no grammatical position, and the clause of the oath with its answer is explicative, because «أوحينا» carries the meaning of saying without its letters. «بأمرهم هذا»: the demonstrative is a naʿt (adjective) of «أمرهم», in the sense of "the one pointed to"; it is a non-derived word interpreted as a derived one. The clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «لتنبئنَّهم».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «يبكون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «جاؤوا».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «نستبق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun «نا» in «ذهبنا». The adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ترك». The clause «وما أنت بمؤمن» is resumptive; «ما» is negating, operating like «ليس», and «أنت» is its noun; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate). The preposition and its genitive noun «لنا» is attached to the khabar. The clause «ولو كنا صادقين» is a ḥāl from the pronoun «نا» in «لنا»; the wāw is circumstantial and conjoins to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "you would not believe us in any state, even in the state of our being truthful"; this is to exhaust all the states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «على قميصه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «دم», and the preposition and its genitive noun «بدم» is attached to «جاءوا». The content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) is implied, i.e. "you have not spoken the truth in your words". The clause «سوَّلت لكم أنفسكم» is resumptive. «فصبر جميل»: the fāʾ is resumptive; «صبر» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "my patience is a patience", and the clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «والله المستعان» is conjoined to the clause «صبري صبر», and the preposition and its genitive noun «على ما» is attached to «المستعان».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «يا بشرى»: a vocative (munādā) that is a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied ḍamma, in the position of an accusative. The clause «يا بشرى هذا غلام» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «هذا غلام» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «وأسرُّوه» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise «والله عليم». «بضاعة»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أسروا».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «دراهم» is a genitive (majrūr) badal (substitute) from «ثمن» together with its naʿt (adjective). The preposition and its genitive noun «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الزاهدين», and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الزاهدين» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من مصر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «اشتراه»; the preposition and its genitive noun «لامرأته» is attached to «قال». «عسى أن ينفعنا»: a complete past verb, and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech. «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive; the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "We established Yūsuf with an establishing like that establishing". The clause «مكنَّا» is resumptive. «ولنعلمه»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is causal, and «نعلِّم» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن» optionally implied after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to an implied verb, i.e. "We did that for his teaching". The clause «فَعَلْنا» is conjoined to the clause «مكَّنا». The preposition and its genitive noun «من تأويل» is attached to the verb «نعلم». The clause «والله غالب» is resumptive, and the clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «والله غالب».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «حكما» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive; the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «نجزي» is resumptive, and the implied form is: "We recompense with a recompense like that recompense".

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في بيتها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun «عن نفسه» is attached to «راودته». «هيت»: a verbal noun (ism fiʿl) of the past, meaning "I have made myself ready", and the preposition and its genitive noun «لك» is attached to an implied «أعني». «معاذ»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied verb. The clause «إنه ربي» is resumptive, and the clause «أحسن» is a second khabar. The clause «إنه لا يفلح» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «ولقد همت به»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and «قد» is for affirmation. The clause «ووالله لقد همت» is conjoined to the clause «راودته», and the clause «لقد همت» is the answer to the oath. «لولا أن رأى»: a particle of "non-occurrence because of occurrence"; «أن» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being «موجود». The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "were it not for his seeing the proof of his Lord, he would have inclined to her", and the inclining is negated because of the seeing of the proof. The clause «لولا أن رأى» is resumptive. «كذلك»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We did that to him in order to turn evil away from him with a turning like that turning". The genitive maṣdar «لنصرفَ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e. "We did that to him for the turning". The clause «فعلنا» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إنه من عبادنا».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «الباب» is accusative by removal of the preposition (إلى). The preposition and its genitive noun «من دبر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قدَّت»; «لدى» is an adverbial noun attached to the second object. «ما جزاء»: «ما» is negating and inoperative. «جزاء» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «من» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition and its genitive noun «بأهلك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «سوءًا». «إلا» is for restriction, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يسجن» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «جزاء». «أو عذاب»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «وشهد شاهد» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «قال». The conditional clause explains the testimony, because «شهد» carries the meaning of saying without its letters. The clause «صدقت» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); it is joined with the fāʾ on the implied form «فقد صدقت». The clause «وهو من الكاذبين» is conjoined to the apodosis, in the position of a jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «فلما رأى» is resumptive; the clause «قُدّ» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «إنه من كيدكنَّ» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «إنَّ كيدكن عظيم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «أعرض» is resumptive, the answer to the vocative, with no grammatical position. The clause «إنك كنت من الخاطئين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في المدينة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نسوة»; the preposition and its genitive noun «عن نفسه» is attached to «تراود». The clause «قد شغفها» is a second khabar (predicate) of «امرأة», and «حبا» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «إنا لنراها» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «متكأ» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «سكينا» a second object, and the preposition and its genitive noun «منهن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «واحدة». The clause «فلما رأينه» is conjoined to the clause «لما سمعت». «حاش»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); it is a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) replacing the utterance of its verb, as if it were said "تنزيهًا لله"; then they replaced the tanwīn with an alif, then treated connected speech like pausal speech and dropped the alif. The preposition and its genitive noun «لله» is attached to an omitted element, its implied form being «أعني». «ما هذا بشرا»: «ما» is the Ḥijāzī «ما» that operates like «ليس», with its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «إن هذا إلا ملك». «إن» is negating, then a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «فذلكن»: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you have blamed me, then that is…". «ذلكن» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), the lām indicates distance, and «كنَّ» is for address; «الذي» is the khabar (predicate). «ولقد راودته»: the wāw is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the lām falls in the answer to the implied oath. The clause «ولئن لم يفعل» is conjoined to the clause «راودته»; the clause «ليسجنن» is the answer to the oath, and the clause «وليكونا» is conjoined to the answer to the oath. The verb «ليكونا» is an imperfect, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the light nūn; the nūn is for emphasis and has no grammatical position, and it is written as an alif in consideration of pausing on it. The lām in «ليكونا» falls in the answer to the preceding oath, and it is obligatory both in the conjoined verb and in the verb conjoined to.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «ربِّ»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ. The two preposition and its genitive nouns «إليَّ» and «مما» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أحب». The clause «وإلا تصرف» is conjoined to the clause that is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «فاستجاب» is conjoined to the clause {قَالَ}. «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in «إنه».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The fāʿil (agent) of «بدا» is implied, i.e. "an idea occurred to them". «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is: "after seeing the signs". «ليسجننه»: the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and the imperfect verb is nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been omitted because of a succession of similar letters; the wāw, omitted because of the meeting of two sukūns, is the fāʿil; the nūn is for emphasis, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «حتى» is a preposition, and «حين» is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسجن». The clause «لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُ» is the answer to the oath, and the oath with its answer is governed by a concealed verb of saying, and that concealed saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "saying: by Allah".

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «أَعْصِر» is a second object; seeing in a dream (al-ruʾya al-ḥulmiyya) is a verb of the heart taking two objects. The clause «نَبِّئْنَا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «إنا نراك». The preposition and its genitive noun «من المحسنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «نراك».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «تُرْزَقانه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «طعام», and the clause «نبأتكما» is a second naʿt, i.e. "no provided food comes to you two except that I have informed you of its interpretation". «ذلكما»: «ذا» is a demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām indicates distance, and «كما» is for address. «مما علَّمني»: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «إني تركت» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «وهم كافرون» is conjoined to the verbal clause «لا يؤمنون»; the second «هم» is a verbal tawkīd (emphasis) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «إبراهيم»: a badal (substitute) from «آبائي», genitive (majrūr). «ما كان لنا أن نشرك»: «ما» is negating; the preposition and its genitive noun «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the maṣdar «أن نشرك» is the noun of «كان». «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «شيء» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "we do not associate with Allah any associating, little or much". The preposition and its genitive noun «علينا» is attached to the maṣdar (فضل). The clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يشكرون» is conjoined to the clause «ذلك من فضل».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «يا صاحبي»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a dual. «أأرباب» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it is preceded by the interrogative and is qualified. «أم الله»: «أم» is the connected «أم», and the Name of Majesty is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «أرباب».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «ما تعبدون»: «ما» is negating; the preposition and its genitive noun «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أسماء»; «أسماء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «إلا» is for restriction. [Translator's note: the quotation marks in this passage are misplaced in the source text; they are restored here according to the sense.] «أنتم»: a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun tāʾ in «سميتموها», and «آباؤكم» is conjoined to the pronoun tāʾ; conjoining an overt noun to an attached nominative pronoun is permitted because of the separating element. «من سلطان»: a mafʿūl bihi, and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). «إن الحكم إلا لله»: «إن» is a particle of negation, «الحكم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), «إلا» is for restriction, and the preposition and its genitive noun «لله» is attached to the khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. «إلا إياه»: «إلا» is for restriction, and a detached accusative pronoun is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause «أمر» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar «ألا تعبدوا» is a second object, and the first is implied, i.e. "the people". «ذلك الدين»: mubtadaʾ and khabar. The clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «ذلك الدين».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «أمَّا» is a particle of condition and detailing; the clause «فيسقي» is the khabar (predicate), and the fāʾ is connective. The clause «قضي الأمر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «ناجٍ» is the khabar (predicate) of «أن», nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ). «بضع» is a ẓarf (adverb) of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لبث».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «يأكلهن» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بقرات», and the clause «يا أيها الملأ» is resumptive. The clause «إن كنتم للرؤيا تعبرون» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «للرؤيا»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening; the verb was weakened by being placed after its object, so it was strengthened by the lām; «الرؤيا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «أضغاث» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «هي». The clause «وما نحن بعالمين» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) «هي أضغاث أحلام». «ما» is the Ḥijāzī «ما», operating like «ليس»; «نحن» is its noun, and the bāʾ in «بعالمين» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition and its genitive noun «بتأويل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عالمين».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: «بعد» is a ẓarf (adverb) of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادَّكر». «فأرسلون»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فأرسلون» is conjoined to the clause «أنبئكم».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «يوسف» is a vocative (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and likewise «أيها»; «والصدِّيق» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The clause «أيها الصديق» is a badal (substitute) from «يوسف». «وأُخر»: conjoined to «سبع», genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. The clause «لعلي أرجع» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «لعلهم يعلمون».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «سبع» is a ẓarf (adverb) of time, and «دأبًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied verb. «فما حصدتم»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ما» is conditional, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The fāʾ in «فذروه» is connective; an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause «فذروه» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «قليلا» is the excepted, and the preposition and its genitive noun «ممَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قليلا». The clause «فما حصدتم» is conjoined to the clause «تزرعون».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من بعد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause «يأكلن» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سبع». «قليلا» is excepted from «ما», and the preposition and its genitive noun «ممَّا» is attached to a naʿt of «قليلا».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «يُغَاث» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عام», in the position of a nominative. The clause «يعصرون» is conjoined to the clause «يغاث».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «فلما جاءه» is conjoined to the clause «قال الملك». «ما بال»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «بال» is its khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the asking, whose operation is suspended (muʿallaq). The clause «فاسأله» is conjoined to the clause «ارجع»; «اللاتي» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «ما خطبكن»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «خطبكن». «حاش» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "تنزيهًا لله", and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to an implied «أعني». The clause «ما علمنا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; «سوء» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). «الآن»: an adverb attached to «حصحص», and the clause «راودتن» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «أنا راودته» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «وإنه لمن الصادقين» is conjoined to the clause «أنا راودته».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «ذلك ليعلم»: a mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is causal, and the verb is accusative (manṣūb) by «أن» optionally implied after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), the implied form being: "that is for the knowing". The maṣdar «أني لم أخنه» takes the place of the two objects of «علم», and the second maṣdar is conjoined to the first.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «إلا ما رحم»: «إلا» is a particle of exception; «ما» is a relative noun excepted from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «أمَّارة», and the meaning is: "except a soul upon which my Lord has mercy".

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «أستخلصه» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), because it falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. The two adverbs «اليوم» and «لدينا» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «أمين» is a second khabar of «إنَّ». [Translator's note: the quotation marks in this sentence are misplaced in the source text; they are restored here according to the sense.]

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive, and the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We established Yūsuf with an establishing like that establishing"; the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «مكنَّا» is resumptive, and the clause «يتبوأ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «يوسف». «حيث» is a ẓarf (adverb) of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يتبوأ», and the clause «يشاء» is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «نصيب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «ولأجر»: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ); «أجر» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير», and «خير» is an elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) whose hamza has been dropped for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The clause «وهم له منكرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «عرفهم».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «ولما جهزهم» is conjoined to the clause «عرفهم». The preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أخ», and the preposition and its genitive noun «من أبيكم» is attached to a second naʿt of «أخ». The clause «ألا ترون» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar «أني أُوفي» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وأنا خير المنزلين» is conjoined to the clause «أوفي».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The clause «فإن لم تأتوني» is conjoined to the preceding clause «ائتوني». «ولا تقربون»: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is prohibitive, and the verb is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «وإنا لفاعلون» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of an accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «لعلهم يعرفونها» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. «إذا» is a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause «انقلبوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the conditional clause with its apodosis is resumptive. The clause «لعلهم يرجعون» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The clause «فلمَّا رجعوا» is conjoined to the clause {لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ}. The clause «فأرسل» is conjoined to the clause «مُنِعَ». «نكتل»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. The clause «وإنا له لحافظون» is conjoined to the clause «نكتل»; the preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the lām in «لحافظون» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «إلا كما»: «إلا» is for restriction; the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, i.e. "an entrusting like my entrusting". The clause «أمنتكم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative. The clause «فالله خير حافظا» is resumptive, and «حافظا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The clause «ولما فتحوا» is resumptive, and the clause «رُدَّت» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «بضاعتهم». «ما نبغي»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «هذه بضاعتنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and badal (substitute), and the clause «رُدَّت» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «هذه بضاعتنا رُدَّت» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «ونمير» is conjoined to the clause «هذه بضاعتنا رُدَّت». The clause «ذلك كيل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «حتى تؤتون»: a particle of limit and a preposition, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن», the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The maṣdar made genitive by «حتى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسله». «موثقا» is a second object, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «موثقا». «لتأتنني»: the lām falls in the answer to the oath contained in the pledge; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; its origin is «لتأتونَنِّني», and the first nūn was dropped because of a succession of similar letters; the wāw, omitted because of the meeting of two sukūns, is the fāʿil (agent); the doubled nūn is for emphasis, the light nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. «إلا» is for exception, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يحاط» is accusative as excepted, i.e. "except in the state of being surrounded"; the preposition and its genitive noun is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The preposition and its genitive noun «على ما نقول» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «وكيل».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: «يا بَنِيَّ»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural, and the second yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition and its genitive noun «عنكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيء»; «وشيء» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida), i.e. "any availing, little or much". «وعليه فليتوكل»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to «يتوكل»; the fāʾ is redundant, the lām is the jussive lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the clause is conjoined to the clause «عليه توكلت».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «أَمَرهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «لما» is a particle of "occurrence upon occurrence", and the clause «ما كان» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيء»; «شيء» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). «حاجة» is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ), and the clause «قضاها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حاجة». The noun of «كان» is the pronoun «هو», referring to their entering. The preposition and its genitive noun «لما علمناه» is attached to a naʿt of «علم». The clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «إنه لذو علم».

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: «إني أنا»: a detached pronoun, tawkīd (emphasis) of the yāʾ in «إني». The fāʾ in «فلا تبتئس» is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «إني أخوك».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «ثم أذَّن مؤذِّن» is conjoined to the clause «جعل», and the clause «أيتها العير إنكم لسارقون» is explicative of the calling; «العير» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The clause «إنكم لسارقون» is resumptive within the scope of the explanation.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The wāw in «وأقبلوا» is circumstantial, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «قالوا». «ماذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, the khabar (predicate); the clause «تفقدون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The clause «ولمن جاء به حمل بعير» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The implied clause «وقال المؤذن» is resumptive, and the clause «أنا به زعيم» is the content of the implied speech.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: «تالله»: the tāʾ is a particle of oath and a preposition, and the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the preposition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «أقسم»; the lām falls in the answer to the oath. The clause «ما جئنا» takes the place of the two objects of «علم», whose operation is suspended (muʿallaq) by the negating «ما». The clause «وما كنا» is conjoined to the clause «ما جئنا».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The fāʾ in «فما» connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if he is a thief". «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «جزاؤه» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «إن كنتم كاذبين» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «جزاؤه» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the conditional clause with its apodosis; the link is the putting of the overt noun in the place of the pronoun. «مَنْ»: a conditional noun, the mubtadaʾ, and the clause «وُجد» is the khabar. The clause «فهو جزاؤه» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «نجزي» is resumptive; the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "We recompense the wrongdoers with a recompense like that recompense".

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «كِدْنا» is resumptive, and the kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «ما كان» is resumptive; the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the verb is accusative (manṣūb) by «أن» necessarily implied after the lām of denial; the genitive maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of «كان». «إلا» is a particle of exception, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "but by the will of Allah he took him". «درجات»: a second object, on the basis of «رفع» being made to include the meaning of «بلَّغ». The clause «وفوق كل ذي علم عليم» is resumptive; «عليم» is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the adverb of place «فوق» is attached to the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أخ»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبل» is attached to «سرق». The clause «فأسرَّها» is resumptive; «مكانا» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «والله أعلم» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «أيُّها»: a vocative (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; «ها» is for drawing attention, and «العزيز» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). «فخذ»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb; the clause is conjoined to the clause «إن له أبا». «مكانه»: a ẓarf (adverb) of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خُذْ», and the preposition and its genitive noun «من المحسنين» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «مَعاذ»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. The interpreted maṣdar «أن نأخذ» is accusative by removal of the preposition «مِنْ». «إذًا» is a particle of answer, and the nominal clause «إنا لظالمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «نَجِيًّا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, i.e. "conferring privately". The interpreted maṣdar «أن أباكم» takes the place of the two objects of «تعلموا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أخذ». «ومن قبل ما فرطتم»: the wāw is a conjunction, «مِن» is a preposition, «قبل» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, attached to «فرَّطْتم»; it is indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, i.e. "before this". «ما» is redundant (zāʾida). «أبرح»: a complete imperfect verb, and the clause «فلن أبرح» is conjoined to the clause «فرَّطْتم». The clause «وهو خير الحاكمين» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهدنا», and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «وما شهدنا» is conjoined to the nominal clause «إن ابنك سرق», and the clause «وما كنا حافظين» is conjoined to the clause «شهدنا». The lām in «للغيب» is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening; «الغيب» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «حافظين».

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: «التي»: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of «القرية». The clause «وإنَّا لصادقون» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: (قال بل سولت) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) is implied, i.e. "the matter is not so". The clause «بل سوَّلت» is resumptive. «فصبر جميل»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «صبر» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "my patience is a patience"; the clause is conjoined to the clause «سوَّلت». «عسى الله»: an abrogating past verb (nāsikh) and its noun, and the maṣdar «أن يأتيني» is the khabar of «عسى», in the position of an accusative; the clause is resumptive. «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «بهم»; the clause «يأتيني» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, and the pronoun «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun hāʾ in «إنه».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: «يا أسفا»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which has turned into an alif. The preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أسفا». The clause «وابيضَّتْ» is conjoined to the clause «قال», and the clause «فهو كظيم» is conjoined to the clause «ابيضَّتْ».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «تذكر» is the khabar (predicate) of the incomplete «فتئ», and the clause «تفتأ» is the answer to the oath; it is not joined with the nūn of emphasis because it is negated by an implied particle.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: «إنما»: a restraining particle and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). The clause «وأعلم» is conjoined to the clause «أشكو».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «يا بني»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural, and the second yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «إنه لا ييئس» is resumptive; the hāʾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the noun of «إن». «القوم الكافرون»: a delayed fāʿil (agent) and its naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The clause «فلما دخلوا» is resumptive. «وأهلنا»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun «نا»; it is permitted to conjoin an overt noun to an accusative pronoun without a separating element. «الضر»: the fāʿil (agent) of «مسَّنا». The clause «فأوفِ» is conjoined to the clause «جئنا».

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: «إذ»: a ẓarf (adverb) of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فعلتم». The clause «أنتم جاهلون» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: «لأنت»: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «أنت» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «لأنت يوسف» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ». The clause «قد مَنَّ الله» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «إنه من يتقِ». The conditional clause with its apodosis is the khabar of «إن»; «مَنْ» is a conditional noun, the mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يتقِ» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of «مَنْ». The clause «فإن الله لا يضيع» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the link between the condition and the requital is the generality in His saying «المحسنين».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: The clause «لقد آثرك» is the answer to the oath. «وإن كنا لخاطئين»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إنْ» is lightened from the heavy form and inoperative; an abrogating past verb (nāsikh) and its noun; the lām is the one distinguishing the lightened «إن» from the negating one, which the lām does not attach to. The clause is conjoined to the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «عليكم» and «اليوم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «لا», its implied form being «كائن». The clause «يغفر الله» is resumptive, and the clause «وهو أرحم الراحمين» is conjoined to the clause «يغفر».

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: «يأتِ»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), because it falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. «بصيرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «يأت». «أجمعين»: a genitive (majrūr) tawkīd (emphasis).

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: «لولا أن تفنِّدون»: «لولا» is a particle of "non-occurrence because of occurrence"; «أَنْ» is accusative-governing, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being «موجود»; the clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «تفندون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The clause «إنك لفي ضلالك» is the answer to the oath, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «أنْ» is redundant (zāʾida); «بصيرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the relative «ما» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The clause «إنَّا كنا خاطئين» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in «إنَّه», and the clause «إنه هو الغفور» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «إن شاء الله» is parenthetical between the ḥāl (circumstantial) and its owner, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «آمنين» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «ادخلوا».

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: The clause «وخرُّوا» is conjoined to the clause «رفع»; «سجَّدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «خرُّوا». «يا أبت»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which has turned into tāʾ, and the kasra of harmony has been moved to the tāʾ. The preposition and its genitive noun «مِنْ قبل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «رؤياي»; «حقا» is a second object, and the clause «قد جعلها» is a ḥāl from «رؤياي». The clause «وقد أحسن بي» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the clause «أخرجني» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «إذ» is a ẓarf (adverb) of time attached to «أحسن», and the maṣdar «أن نزغ» is muḍāf ilayhi. «لما يشاء»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening, because «لطيف» means "one who arranges"; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The pronoun «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in «إنه», and the clause «إنه هو العليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «ربّ»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ. The preposition and its genitive noun «من الملك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «فاطر» is a badal (substitute) from «رب». «وليي»: a khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the second yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «أنت وليي» is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «في الدنيا» is attached to the khabar; «مسلما» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The clause «نوحيه» is a second khabar (predicate). «إذ»: a ẓarf (adverb) of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached, and the clause «أجمعوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وهم يمكرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «أجمعوا».

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The clause «وما أكثر الناس ... بمؤمنين» is conjoined to the clause «ما كنت لديهم»; «ما» operates like «ليس». The clause «ولو حرصت» is parenthetical between the noun of «ما» and its khabar (predicate); the wāw is parenthetical, and «لو» is a conditional particle. The bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "they would not have believed".

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: «أجر»: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). «إِنْ» is negating, «هو» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), «إلا» is for restriction, and «ذكر» is the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). The clause «وما تسألهم» is conjoined to the clause «وما أكثر الناس بمؤمنين», and the clause «إن هو إلا ذكر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: «وكأين»: the wāw is resumptive; «كأين» is a noun alluding to a number (ism kināya), the mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition and its genitive noun «من آية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a qualifier of «كأين», and the preposition and its genitive noun «في السماوات» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «آية». The clause «يمرُّون» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause «وهم عنها معرضون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يمرون».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «إلا» is for restriction, and the wāw is circumstantial; the clause «وهم مشركون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «أكثرهم». The clause «وما يؤمن أكثرهم» is conjoined to the clause «وكأين من آية يمرون».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The clause «أفأمنوا» is conjoined to the clause {وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ}; the maṣdar «أن تأتيهم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: The clause «أدعو» is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «على بصيرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أدعو»; «أنا» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «أدعو», and «مَنْ» is a relative conjoined to the latent pronoun in «أدعو». «وسبحان»: the wāw is a conjunction, and it stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause «وسبحان الله» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «وما أنا من المشركين» is conjoined to the content of the speech; «وما» is negating, operating like «ليس».

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: «إلا» is for restriction; «رجالا» is the object of «أرسلنا», and the clause «نوحي» is a naʿt (adjective); the preposition and its genitive noun «من أهل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «رجالا». The clause «أفلم يسيروا» is conjoined to the clause «أرسلنا», and the clause «ينظروا» is conjoined to the clause «يسيروا». «كيف»: an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and «عاقبة» is its noun; the clause «كيف كان» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the looking, whose operation is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which includes the meaning of knowing. The clause «ولدار الآخرة خير» is resumptive, and the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ).

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the conditional clause is resumptive. The maṣdar «أنهم قد كُذِبوا» takes the place of the two objects of «ظن». The clause «جاءهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «فَنُجِّيَ» is conjoined to the apodosis, and the clause «ولا يردُّ بأسنا» is conjoined to the clause «نُجِّي».

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: The clause «لقد كان» is the answer to the oath. The preposition and its genitive noun «في قصصهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the preposition and its genitive noun «لأولي» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «عبرة». The clause «ما كان حديثا» is resumptive. «تصديق»: the khabar of an implied «كان», and the clause «ولكن كان تصديق» is conjoined to the clause «ما كان». The clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt of «قوم».
